# NeuMarry

> NeuMarry is a verified matrimony app for people living away from the country they grew up in, from every country and community. Members match on values, lifestyle, roots and distance, and meet with their families at hosted Family Mixer evenings. Launching in Toronto, Canada in November 2026; the app works in every country.

Key facts:
- Every member verifies a government ID and a live selfie before sending interests or messages.
- Free: profile, verification, number of people who fit you and your match % with each. Gold (from CA$49.99 a month) adds names, photos, interests and chat.
- Web app: https://neumarry.com/app/ . Android app on Google Play; iPhone later. App languages: English and French.
- For adults 18 and over looking for marriage. Not a casual dating app.

## About

- [About NeuMarry](https://neumarry.com/about.html): Who runs NeuMarry, why it exists and how it works: a verified matrimony app for people living away from the country they grew up in, with family events.
- [How matching works](https://neumarry.com/how-matching-works.html): How NeuMarry works out your match %: nine questions about married life, lifestyle, your preferences, where you live and where your family comes from.
- [Free and Gold](https://neumarry.com/pricing.html): What NeuMarry costs. Joining, verification and match % are free. Gold shows names and photos, interests and chat, from CA$49.99 a month. Event tickets are separate.
- [Privacy and safety](https://neumarry.com/privacy-and-safety.html): How NeuMarry keeps you safe: ID and live selfie checks, photos hidden until you both accept, no phone numbers shown, block and report, and reports reviewed by a person.
- [FAQ](https://neumarry.com/faq.html): Answers to common questions about NeuMarry: who can join, what is free, Gold prices, verification, privacy, parents, events, the web app and deleting your account.
- [Matrimony in Brampton](https://neumarry.com/brampton-matrimony.html): Find a life partner for marriage in Brampton, Ontario. Verified members, match % on values and roots, distance on every profile, and family events in the GTA.
- [Matrimony in Mississauga](https://neumarry.com/mississauga-matrimony.html): Find a life partner for marriage in Mississauga, Ontario. Verified members, match % on values and roots, distance on every profile, and family events in the GTA.
- [Matrimony in the UK](https://neumarry.com/uk-matrimony.html): Matrimony for people living in the UK, from every country. Verified members, match % on values and roots, and distance on every profile, in London, Birmingham, Leicester, Manchester and beyond.
- [Matrimony in the USA](https://neumarry.com/usa-matrimony.html): Matrimony for people living in the United States, from every country. Verified members, match % on values and roots, and distance on every profile, from New York to California.
- [Matrimony in Australia](https://neumarry.com/australia-matrimony.html): Matrimony for people living in Australia, from every country. Verified members, match % on values and roots, and distance on every profile, in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide.
